# Shirley

## Overview

- **Role:** schoolteacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P24](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0024)</sub>

- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Shirley is a schoolteacher from the "down east" region. She is characterized by her red hair and striking, wonderful eyes.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P24](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0024)_

## History

Shirley was born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). Shirley's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), later asked [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to deliver a message to Miss Lavendar to inform her of his intended visit. Upon arriving at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), Stephen was greeted on the porch by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before reuniting with Miss Lavendar, and he subsequently married her in a lovely ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), +7 more_

## Quotes

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> “I’m going back to school,” she announced. “That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> “I think he has only been its nominal head for many years,” said Anne. “He is a very old man; his nephews are really at the head of the institution.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035)

> “If I had been the boy you sent for,” said Anne wistfully, “I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

> "I know by experience that it’s very unpleasant to have one’s name spelled wrong and I suppose it must be even worse to have it pronounced wrong."
>
> — Shirley — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016)

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Shirley and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) began as intense academic rivals in school, competing closely through their studies until Shirley won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) earned the medal. As time passed and they finished their schooling, their dynamic softened. While tidying up [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) after Miss Lavendar's wedding, a brief romantic spark between them hints at a shifting connection.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +9 more_

- Rival of — academic rivals in school  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--shirley.md)

Shirley and Charlotta the Fourth enjoy a friendly acquaintance around [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides in Shirley regarding Miss Lavendar's melancholic mood, prompting Shirley to visit and help cheer her up. Shirley frequently interacts with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) while assisting with wedding preparations for Miss Lavendar and tidying up the lodge after the ceremony.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), +19 more_

- Friend of — chums (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

Shirley serves as [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's teacher at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, quickly forming a close bond with him as her favorite pupil. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) brings her flowers on her first day and writes imaginative assignments that Shirley greatly admires. Beyond the classroom, they spend leisure time together walking to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), and Shirley stays connected with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) while helping facilitate his father's reunion and marriage to Miss Lavendar.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), +24 more_

- Friend of — student fond of his teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)</sub>
- Mentor of — teacher and pupil (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)</sub>
